Cut to a low-angle shot of multiple figures walking in orange NASA launch-entry suits (Advanced Crew Escape Suits), showing only their torsos and legs from below. Next is a tight macro shot of a name patch on an orange suit reading "VICTOR GLOVER" with a Navy aviator wings emblem on a blue badge. A subsequent shot shows two helmeted astronauts in orange suits standing against a black background, American flag patches visible on their shoulders. This dissolves to a nearly black frame with faint star-like specks — suggesting open space. Then a brief overexposed/washed-out frame showing what appear to be two rocket nozzle or thruster components symmetrically framed against a pale background. A shot of the upper stage of a large white rocket on a launch pad is shown, prominently bearing "NASA" in red worm lettering, the NASA meatball logo, and an "esa" (European Space Agency) logo, with mist/vapor around the base. The final frames show a CGI/animated render of a rocket ascending against a black sky with blazing engine exhaust flames visible beneath its engines, consistent with the Space Launch System (SLS) or similar heavy-lift vehicle.
